g.text: Which stimulated recipient changes the response?
Current 10 to the declared target(s) · frozen memory · same six historical images · activity carried between images

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #42536a

g.text: All four both-target controls must reproduce the original full-neuron count bins before isolation.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #42536a

g.text: A neuron can spike when it is not directly stimulated. Counts alone do not separate direct current from network feedback.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #42536a

g.text: The heatmap compares full-observation totals, not spike timing. Different neural responses need not change the decoded action.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #42536a

g.text: Post-hoc mechanism diagnostic: no trading account, returns, learning, or automatic policy promotion.
